svg.text: esp32s3_can_sd_ble_sync_server · SD module with AMS1117 feeds 3V3p · optional RTC
TX → TX, RX → RX (not crossed like UART)
100 nF at transceiver and RTC VCC
All GND are common (car GND = board GND).
TJA1051T/3: VCC = 5V, VIO = 3.3 V (ESP), S = VIO in the car (hardware silent).
DS3231 MH board with CR2032: remove the charging resistor.
GPIO7: LOW = ignition on (internal pull-up, RTC pull-up in sleep).
CAN_LISTEN_ONLY 1 in the car. Remove LEDs on modules to cut sleep current.
